Spec Item Number Spec Item Headline Motivation Applies to Model element [TPS_SYST_02015] LdCom: only one ISignal mapped to the ISignalIPdu . LdCom only supports one ISig- nal per PDU. Rx + Tx ISignalToIPduMapping [TPS_SYST_02016] LdCom: only Transformer output and UINT8_N or UINT8_DYN sup- ported. LdCom only supports Byte Array Signals. Rx + Tx ISignal [TPS_SYST_02017] LdCom: Opaque ISignalToIP- duMapping . packingByteOrder . LdCom only supports Byte Array Signals. Rx + Tx ISignalToIPduMapping [TPS_SYST_02018] LdCom: ISignalToIPduMap- ping . startPosition shall be 0. LdCom only supports Signals start- ing in the first byte of the PDU. Rx + Tx ISignalToIPduMapping [TPS_SYST_02019] LdCom: ISignalToIPduMap- ping . transferProperty shall be triggered or triggeredWith- outRepetition. LdCom only supports one ISignal per PDU. That signal has to trigger the transmission. Tx ISignalToIPduMapping [TPS_SYST_02020] LdCom: No IPduTiming . mini- mumDelay defined. LdCom does not support event trig- gered transmission with repetitions. Tx ISignalIPdu [TPS_SYST_02021] LdCom: ISignalToIPduMap- ping . updateIndicationBit- Position shall not be defined. LdCom does not support update bits. Rx + Tx ISignalToIPduMapping [TPS_SYST_02022] LdCom: Only the transmission- ModeTrueTiming defined. LdCom does not support transmis- sion modes. Tx ISignalIPdu [TPS_SYST_02023] LdCom: DataFilter "always" if TransmissionModeCondition defined. LdCom does not support transmis- sion modes. Tx ISignalIPdu [TPS_SYST_02024] LdCom: No ModeDrivenTrans- missionModeCondition de- fined. LdCom does not support transmis- sion modes. Tx ISignalIPdu [TPS_SYST_02025] LdCom: Only EventCon- trolledTiming defined. LdCom does not support cyclic transmission. Tx ISignalIPdu [TPS_SYST_02026] LdCom: Only EventCon- trolledTiming with no repetition defined. LdCom does not support cyclic transmission nor repeated trans- mission. Tx ISignalIPdu [TPS_SYST_02027] LdCom: No ISignalPort . time- out reception timeout defined. LdCom does not support timeout handling. Rx ISignalPort Spec Item Number Spec Item Headline Motivation Applies to Model element [TPS_SYST_02164] LdCom: No ISignalPort . firstTimeout reception timeout defined. LdCom does not support timeout handling. Rx ISignalPort [TPS_SYST_02028] LdCom: No ISignalPort . dataFilter defined. LdCom does not support timeout handling. Rx ISignalPort [TPS_SYST_03001] LdCom: ISignalIPdu not part of any ISignalIPduGroup . LdCom does not support ISig- nalIPduGroup s. Rx + Tx ISignalIPdu
